accuracy_notes: Ofcom January 2026 current coverage was separated from January 2029 conditional planned deployment.
BDUK monthly Project Gigabit management information was not treated as contractual milestone compliance or parcel service evidence.
BDUK OMR/address-checker classifications were retained as dated planning/availability evidence with explicit accuracy limitations.
4G/5G predicted coverage and crowdsourced performance were not converted into guaranteed parcel signal or capacity.
NPPF and telecom planning guidance were retained as policy/process evidence rather than automatic planning permission or Code-right access.
No parcel relation, Future Growth score, business row, service guarantee or build date was fabricated.
